hook: In 1661, Europe printed its first banknotes, and triggered a complete financial collapse.

sections.voiceover: In 1661, Europe printed its first banknotes, and triggered a complete financial collapse.
b_roll: Historical bank building exterior in Stockholm

sections.voiceover: Stockholms Banco launched under founder Johan Palmstruch in Stockholm. Minting lower-weight coins altered currency values after Karl X Gustav died. Where did the 1660 crisis leave the bank?
Stockholms Banco faced total liquidation by 1667.
Sveriges Riksbank emerged from the wreckage in 1668. Riksens Ständers Bank replaced the broken system.
Central banking was born from this exact 1667 collapse.
